profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Mount Pleasant, Michigan, that supports educators through professional development, coaching and training programs such as Cognitive Coaching and Adaptive Schools. It also offers curriculum materials and educational products. It is also the organization behind Epicenter, a software platform used by charter school authorizers to manage oversight and compliance documents.
